name: cake-jobs-scraper
title: Cake Jobs Scraper: Taiwan and Asia Jobs
description: Scrape job listings from Cake.me, the job board of Taiwan and Asia: title, company, places, salary, seniority, job type, tags and, on request, the full description and company profile. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# Cake Jobs Scraper Scrape job ads from [Cake.me](https://www.cake.me/), the job board for Taiwan and Asia. Search by keyword, place and filter, or paste a Cake.me result page. You get one row per job with the company, places, job type, seniority, salary when it is published, tags and more. Turn on job page details to also get the full description, the requirements, the interview process, the posting and expiry dates, the view counters and the company profile. Details cost the same per job. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/cake-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `cake-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "engineer" (software engineer roles in Taipei). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input All fields are optional. An empty input runs the sample below: 5 engineer jobs. ```json { "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "engineer" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | | --- | --- | | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as engineer, designer or marketing. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to list the newest jobs. | | `locations` | Places written as on Cake.me from small to large, for example `Taipei City, Taiwan`. Each place is its own search. One place per line when you paste a text. | | `jobTypes` | full_time, part_time, internship, contract, freelance, temporary, volunteer. | | `seniorityLevels` | entry_level, mid_senior_level, associate, internship_level, director, executive. | | `inclusivityTraits` | gender_equity, career_change, back_to_work, lgbtq, foreign_talents, disability_confident, senior_citizen. | | `startUrls` | Result pages copied from Cake.me, such as `https://www.cake.me/jobs/engineer`. Their filters are kept, the page number is ignored. | | `includeDetails` | Also read the job page of each job. Default off. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Most jobs per search. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Most jobs for the whole run. Default 200, 0 means no limit. | Keywords, places and filters are combined: two keywords, two places and one job type make four searches. A job that several searches find is returned once. ## Sample output A job with details turned on (long texts cut here): ```json { "id": "tsmc/frontend-software-engineer-6e2a2e", "job_path": start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. The start fee is the `apify-actor-start` event, charged once per run by Apify. Each job in the dataset is one `job-result` event. A job is never charged twice, also not when a run restarts or when several searches find the same job. Set a maximum cost per run in the run options and the actor stops before it goes over: the status then says "Stopped at the max charge limit." ## Related Actors - [Seek, JobStreet & JobsDB Scraper - Jobs Data of 8 Countries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/seek-scraper): Jobs from Seek, JobStreet and JobsDB, including Thailand. - [foundit.in Job Scraper: India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/foundit-in-scraper): Jobs from foundit in India and South East Asia. - [JobKorea Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobkorea-kr-scraper): South Korean job listings from JobKorea. - [Naukri Scraper - India & Middle East Jobs, Salaries, Skills](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/naukri-scraper): Jobs, salaries and skills from Naukri. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one search return?** Cake.me shows at most 50 pages of 10 jobs, so 500 jobs per search. To get more, split the work: use several keywords, places or filters. Every search can return its own 500. **What are jobs from company career sites?** Cake.me also lists jobs that sit on the employer's own site. They have `source_type` external and the address of the employer site in `job_url`. They have no job page on Cake.me, so the Detail columns stay null for them. All other columns that the result list carries are filled. **Why is the salary empty?** Many employers do not publish a salary, and some hide it on purpose. The actor never invents a value. With details on, `salary_hidden` tells you when the employer hides it. **Why did my run end with 0 jobs and a message about the Apify proxy?** Cake.me protects its keyword and place pages, and they only load through the UNBLOCKER proxy group of Apify. If your plan does not include it, the run says so and delivers no jobs for those searches. The plain listing without a keyword still works. Run again on a plan with UNBLOCKER, or use only start addresses of the plain listing. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/cake-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
